messages:
maria (CS): forwarding a customer report — after today's canary flip they're seeing our API return {} for optional fields instead of null and their strict validator rejects it.

maria (CS): Customer pasted the error:
```
ValidationError: field 'metadata' expected nullable object or null
received type: object (empty)
```

maria (CS): Their sample response from our endpoint:
```
{
  \"id\": \"evt_123\",
  \"type\": \"order\",
  \"metadata\": {}
}
```

maria (CS): Previously it came back as: 
```
{
  \"id\": \"evt_123\",
  \"type\": \"order\",
  \"metadata\": null
}
```

ben (Eng): :thinking: Thanks — can you confirm which model/variant rolled in the canary and the rollout id? Need to reproduce.

devin (SRE): Noted. We see a spike of 4xx from that org starting ~2026-03-16T11:04Z. Canary label looks like rollout/2026-03-16-canary-7. Pushing sample request traces.

devin (SRE): Forwarded request stub we got: 
```
POST /v1/generate
{
  \"model\": \"rwd-1.3f-serve-v2\",
  \"input\": \"...\",
  \"options\": {\"format\":\"json_schema\", \"schema_version\":\"2026-03-15\"}
}
```

ben (Eng): Repro attempt: when schema_version header is present our post-processor converts empty arrays/objects to {} instead of null in one code path. That behavior changed in PR #6423 (intended to help JS consumers) — looks like strict validators regressed.

maria (CS): Customer impact: nightly ingest job dropped ~5k events, pipeline alerts firing, they're urgent for a workaround. :exclamation:

ben (Eng): Short-term fix: add a compatibility toggle that normalizes empty object -> null for orgs that need strict schema. I can push a hotfix to post-processing. Thoughts @devin?

devin (SRE): Go for it but gate behind a feature flag and enable only for affected org ids. I'll watch logs. Correlation ids to look at: r-abc123, r-def456 (samples included).

maria (CS): Please paste rollback/mitigation steps here so I can update the customer. They prefer a server-side transform vs changing their validator.

ben (Eng): Plan: 1) implement compat flag in post-processor (empty-object -> null), 2) deploy to canary then prod, 3) enable for affected org ids, 4) monitor error rate and ingestion throughput for 2 hours, 5) follow up with permanent config option. ETA ~3h.

ingest-bot: [automation] Created incident INC-20260316-12 for 'schema null vs empty-object regression' and assigned to eng. Link: https://incidents/redwood/INC-20260316-12

maria (CS): Copying affected org ids and full request examples to this thread. Customer is OK with temporary transform. :thumbsup:

ben (Eng): Opening PR now and will ping here when deployed.

ben (Eng): Deployed hotfix to canary and enabled compat flag for orgs X,Y,Z. Error rate for those orgs dropped ~0.8% -> 0.03%.

maria (CS): Customer confirmed ingest resumed and alerts silenced. Marking as stable for now — will follow up tomorrow with postmortem and permanent config options.

ben (Eng): Filing follow-up RFC on whether post-processor should default to null or add explicit schema-mode opt-in.

maria (CS): Thanks team — I'll close the customer loop and add notes to the ticket.
